proposals.evidence: Full sūcī section 1 gives Prakrit sūī, Hindi sūī, Marathi sūī and Gujarati soy “needle”. The selected Bhil hūī/hūi/hūe/huye forms retain the contracted vowel/glide sequence with regional s-to-h development; they do not retain the medial affricate/nasal defining section 2 *sūñcī. Regional contact versus inheritance is not resolved by the family link.
